title: Conserving reservoir state operator and synthetic verification
purpose: Implement and verify a daily storage-release operator that conserves total water, fast/slow source tracers and an explicit residence-time age moment.
hard_constraints: one storage state per reservoir entity
one release location per reservoir entity
storage never exceeds capacity after spill
fast-origin, slow-origin and direct-water tracers close within scale-aware numerical tolerance
each authorized reservoir control edge must equal the locked Reach downstream edge
reservoir cascades follow the real Reach graph even when ordinary Reaches separate two reservoirs
upstream reservoir release enters a downstream reservoir exactly once
disabled operator exactly recovers the no-reservoir routing parent

assumptions.mixing: complete mixing of conservative water-source tracers within each reservoir; fast and slow labels denote origin, not separate outlet pathways
assumptions.age: old stock ages one day, new inflow and precipitation enter at age zero, then E, W, controlled release and spill remove the mixed stock; the saved value is the first moment, not a full age distribution
assumptions.precipitation: separate direct-water tracer, not silently assigned to fast or slow water
assumptions.water_level: not converted to storage without a registered elevation-storage curve
assumptions.within_step_flux_order: evaporation, withdrawal above its registered intake floor, controlled release above dead storage, then unlimited emergency spill
assumptions.spill: unlimited emergency spill is a structural overflow safeguard; flood-routing claims require a later registered spillway-capacity module

seasonal_target_curve.form: low-dimensional periodic baseline plus one smooth flood-season drawdown window
seasonal_target_curve.calendar_rule: month-day phase is preserved across leap and non-leap years
seasonal_target_curve.interpretation: literature constrains phase, width and magnitude priors; it does not hard-code monthly releases

forbidden: route a reservoir twice because it spans multiple Reach features
re-split reservoir release by the current inflow fast fraction
success: All deterministic synthetic tests pass with absolute tolerance 1e-6 m3 plus relative tolerance 1e-12, including a 1e10 m3 large-reservoir test.
